notes.title: The Story Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/109d2f90ee1111f07e0cae8cddcce246adf1f6d8.png[/img]

[b]BEHOLD Wish Seekers![/b]

To the actual final finisher update for Wish World.
This is possibly the biggest update added to the game.

Here's a Major game changing update!

Patch Notes:

[b]Major update![/b]
[list]
[*] Full Controller Support.
[*] NPC dialogue system has been completely re-vamped!
[*] Added many more NPCs into different levels and almost over 300 different pieces of text with story and more.
[*] Added new songs to certain levels.
[*] Certain levels have a chance to spawn rain.
[*] Lava Lake has been changed to be more unique and interesting compared to other levels.
[*] Updated many level layouts.
[*] Fixed a lighting issue with NPC Campfires.
[*] Made it impossible to take damage after kicking an enemy, and kicked enemies give lives upon death.
[*] Added a door to leave levels at the start of each level. (besides the final new level)
[*] Re-vamped the rock couples models.
[*] Added more Charm.
[*] Added a vendor that sells Lives that costs coins. (it gives coins more of a use)
[*] Fixed navigator of enemies in levels.
[*] Other small tweaks and changes (Too many to list)
[*] Added another plane Under the Wish Plane.
[*] Added stone tablets with story elements.
[*] The Hotdog Seller has a limit on his hotdogs and more than 1 can be purchased.
[*] Now each NPC has a Unique sound effect when talking.
[*] Added 3 new achievements.
[*] Added the ability to read graves.
[*] Made the HUD more user-friendly.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/2ab8962b7895f83390536f8a4449081ad5af6668.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156063/aaa80d4a1ea6299ae19d96ade703a6faaa323340.png[/img][/url]
[*] Updated the Menu/options/pausing HUDs to make them easy to read and navigate.
[*] Added a brief intro to the game and ending cut-scene to the game.
[*] Added some unique sound effects.
[*] Added one final ultra difficult level that combines everything in Wish World in one final level.
[/list]

Thank you for any new players coming in or older players for supporting Wish World. Being a solo developer isn't easy but its so enjoyable hearing the feedback from people who end up playing and enjoying the game.

This I think is the final update probably last update ;) (I think) To be for Wish World.

If you enjoy the update, Please Give it a Review. and invite your friends to try the game!
Wish Seekers Thank you for being you. Seriously. See you in the next game! <3

The second project I was working on I have also finished and will be uploaded to steam soon.

Thank you so much for being with Wish World!
And Remember - "Keep Striving For Greatness!" ~Ryan :)

notes.title: The Difficulty Update
notes.notes:
[b]HELLO Wish Seekers![/b]

I hope your enjoying wish world, Wish Seekers!
Here's a small game changing update!

Patch Notes:

[b]Minor Update.[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies can now be kicked around when you run behind them.
[*] Upon saving the game will let you know with green text that the save was successful.
[*] Added a star that heals the player for 1 hp point when picked up.
[*] Fixed Certain NPC's and added more decorations to levels.
[*] Fixed the "A Dapper Solution Achievement"
[/list]
[b]Major update![/b]
[list]
[*] When inside of a expert level the Player cannot; Dive Down, Dive Forward or wall Hop.
[*] Coins no longer heal the Player.
[/list]
